seller_or_subject: Medium — Creator reports $33,000 in 3 months on Payhip
what: A Medium author claims $33,000 in Payhip sales over 3 months using email marketing and articles.
verbatim_snippet: "I've made $33,000 on Payhip in 3 months without being a slave to social media. I've used email marketing mostly and articles."
notes: Author (Edina Jackson) has multiple Medium posts about Payhip income and appears to be a content marketer/affiliate. Claims should be treated with skepticism. Original ID: C3.
